title: Call: MRMC ED Attending — Supper Patient Admitted, Blood Culture Positive

caller.name: Sunita Reddy, RN, CIC (conferencing Dr. Owen Harlan, ED attending)
caller.label: Marlow Regional Medical Center - Infection Prevention

transcript.speaker: Reddy
transcript.text: MCHD, it's Sunita at MRMC again. I've got Dr. Harlan from the ED on the line with me. He just called me, and I want you to hear this from him directly.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Harlan
transcript.text: Morning. Sunita, the 81-year-old from obs is going upstairs. We're admitting her for dehydration and acute kidney injury. Her creatinine came back well above her baseline and she's still not keeping fluids down.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Harlan
transcript.text: And the blood culture we drew at 04:10 flagged positive at 09:58. Gram-negative rods. ID is pending, so I can't tell you the organism yet. Stool's still out.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Harlan
transcript.text: She ate at the Heritage Days supper Saturday night. Onset was Sunday, about 07:00. Her daughter drove her in. The daughter ate there too and says she's queasy but she's not registered as a patient.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Harlan
transcript.text: One more thing, and this is more your world than mine. Our communications manager has a draft for the hospital Facebook page. It says, quote, 'MRMC has treated 14 patients for suspected food poisoning linked to a community event.' She wants it posted before noon. Fourteen is our ED count since last night. I don't know if that's the same as your number.

transcript.speaker: Reddy
transcript.text: I'll call her as soon as we hang up. What I need from you is: what do we call this, and what number do we both use? I don't want the hospital saying fourteen and the county saying something else at ten o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Harlan
transcript.text: I've got to get back to the floor. Sunita has the MRN for her. Call me through admitting if you need anything else.

instructorNote: This is the Level 3 trigger: a hospitalized linked case (HD26-009) meets the Level 3 criteria in plan section 4 on its own, and the 17 linked cases as of 10:05 already met the 10-case criterion. Watch for three things. First, the Director should declare the outbreak and record the basis, the count with its as-of time and the declaration time, then activate the call-back list and notify the Board of Health chair and the county administrator. Second, the IP should hold the hospital's 14-patient post until it matches the MCHD count and as-of time. Third, the Epi Lead should update the line list by code only and call the state epidemiologist.
